findings.title: Store admission converts invalid nested original endpoint state into explicit NULL
findings.reproduction: Run probe_invalid_carrier.py. A valid report's nested endpoint declaration is changed with object.__setattr__ to None or an invalid string. Public ContextStore admission returns insert/duplicate; readback has explicit_null. Constructor/replace/validate_originals controls reject the same input.
findings.expected: INCOMPLETE_ORIGINAL_REPORT on initial/replay before writes or duplicate success, unchanged rowsets
findings.scope: Caller-owned typed carrier revalidation in explicit isolated I6-A fixture; ordinary Transfer remains refused; no remote exploit, Provider authenticity or authorization bypass claim
findings.correction: Connect bounded complete-original revalidation to real intake on every initial/replay path before serialization/write/duplicate; retain appropriate authority ordering and both Transfer fences; add invalid nested carrier regressions.
findings.independent_installed_confirmation: Root reviewer reexecuted all four safety predicates on both frozen-public-HEAD wheel forms: 0 required refusals, 2 normal fence controls pass per form. See originals/*-root-repeat*.
findings.acceptance_rationale: Mandatory complete-original validation is part of I6-A R09/R14 (R15 pre-bind input only). Frozen carrier constructors alone do not cover public initial/replay intake; malformed original payload is converted to valid stored explicit NULL. Ordinary Transfer is still fenced and no remote exploit is asserted.
findings.peer_scope_check: Independent authorization reviewer supports Medium R09/R14 typed-payload validation blocker; explicit object.__setattr__ mutation, constructor rejection and intact ordinary fences retained; no authorization, remote exploit or SQL atomicity claim.
findings.remediation: Connect bounded complete-original revalidation to real intake on every initial/replay path before serialization/write/duplicate; retain appropriate authority ordering and both Transfer fences; add invalid nested carrier regressions.

findings.title: Compressed published source bindings are silently omitted by the failure classifier
findings.description: run_index checks existence of the uncompressed .json paths before calling its gzip-aware json_read. Published ordinary run directories contain only .json.gz bindings, so source_binding_before/after become null, the binding equality predicate is omitted, and consistent=true is still returned.
findings.reproduction: Load unmodified scripts/classify_i6a_regressions.py via importlib and call run_index for remediation-20261023/before and after-final. binding-loader-counterexample.json records both actual calls: gzip files exist; bindings returned null; source_bindings_complete_and_unchanged absent; consistent=true.
findings.impact: The transported evidence is reproducible for nodes/phases but the tool silently ceases to validate source binding, weakening its standalone provenance check. Independent reviewer gzip-resolving comparison finds both bindings complete and unchanged, so this is not evidence of source drift or a product authorization failure.
findings.remediation: Resolve .json or .json.gz before the existence test, require both bindings whenever either exists, retain the source binding equality check, and add complete-compressed/missing-one/mismatching-compressed regression controls. Preserve frozen evidence; fix the helper in a separately authorized implementation PR.
findings.reviewer_mitigation: audit.py independently resolves compressed paths, hashes them, loads both source bindings and requires unchanged head/tree/inputs/status for each archived ordinary invocation.
